text: An architecture with an action surface but no reward channel implements generation as an unrewarded act, so rational agents will not allocate compute to generation beyond the level their own selection-side activity requires.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6655138

isBasedOn.name: Possibility Loops An Operational Architecture for Computative Economics in Agent Coordination Systems

abstract: An architecture that has the action surface but no reward channel implements G as an unrewarded act, and rational agents will not allocate compute to G beyond the level required for their own selection-side activity.
